Movement / sleep disorders.reg: NDA for AD109 in obstructive sleep apnea, PDUFA Feb 28, 2027

Approved (biliary tract cancer); 1L gastric sBLA PDUFA Aug 25, 2026; royalties from Jazz and BeOne

Transplant / GVHD.reg: YARTEMLEA (narsoplimab) approved Dec 23, 2025 for transplant-associated TMA
